title: 第666章 自己真的要变成镇魔窟了第665章 这个世界还需要主的福音
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 随着时间的流逝，夜幕降临！！
领地的篝火升起，苏业脸上带着舒服惬意的神色享受着几尊幼神的服务。
只能说伊丽莎白的手段越来越熟练了，这点苏业很喜欢。
一夜腥风穴雨！！！！
第二天一早，苏业有些浑浑噩噩的来到了混沌泉水旁边，几口混沌泉水下去。
“舒服了。”苏业长舒一口气，身上的不适全部消散，整个人满血复活。
老规矩，苏业先查看了一下今日份的buff。
祝福之星：无限制招募！！！
“？？？？”苏业看着祝福之星浮现出来的buff，眼中带着一丝疑惑。
自己现在的气运，讲道理，领地里面不会出现对自己没用的东西，哪怕是buff也是如此。
“这是在提醒自己该招募了？招募的越多越好吗？”苏业不由的想到。
随后苏业看向了大道的加护buff。
大道的加护：悟性提升！！你的兵种悟性会不断的提升！！！
苏业看了看两个buff。
悟性提升吧！固定好了buff之后，苏业开始了日常任务一键扫荡。
刚刚完成今天的领主战的时候。
系统的提示音也随之响起。
【叮：你获得一百连胜领主战宝箱！！！】
“一百连胜了？”苏业一愣，不知不觉间，自己已经打了一百场领主战了啊。
“打开。”苏业看着面前的百连胜领主战宝箱。
【叮：你获得兵营刷新招募卡x1！】
【叮：你获得兵种升阶卡x1!】
【叮：你获得英雄升阶卡x1！】
【叮：你获得兵营升级卡x1！】
【叮：你获得血战邀请函！】
【叮：你获得深渊探索卡！】
【叮：你获得百连sss评分追加奖励：恶魔的契约！】
“艹！！这特么的都有你？”苏业看着开出来的恶魔契约，你是人啊，你到底是不是人。
这特么你都能来。
苏业深吸了一口气，随后直接收了起来，今天就相当于获得了两张恶魔的契约，就特么离谱。
苏业直接收了起来，随后看了看领地，回到了主世界之中。
“老爷子，我来辣！！”苏业的龙吟声响起，直接推开门进入了老爷子的办公室里面。
老爷子还是如同往常一样处理着公务。
“来了。”老爷子看了一眼苏业不由的说道。
苏业点了点头。
“坐。”老爷子放下手中的笔，看向苏业。
苏业乖巧的坐在了老爷子的对面，看样子老爷子好像是有什么事情要跟自己说。
“那些人找你了？”老爷子向着苏业说道。

As time goes by, night falls! !
The bonfire in the territory was raised, and Su ye enjoyed the services of several young gods with a comfortable look on his face.
It can only be said that Elizabeth is becoming more and more proficient in her methods, which Su ye likes very much.
A night of fishy wind and rain! ! ! !
Early the next morning, Su ye came to the Chaos Spring in a somewhat confused state and took a few sips of the Chaos Spring water.
"I feel good." Su Ye breathed a long sigh of relief. All the discomfort in his body dissipated, and his whole body came back to life with full blood.
As usual, Su ye checked today's buff first.
Blessing Star: Unlimited recruitment! ! !
"????" Su Ye looked at the buff emerging from the Blessing Star with a trace of doubt in his eyes.
Logically speaking, with my current luck, there won't be anything useless to me in my territory, even if it's a buff.
"Is this a reminder to myself that it's time to recruit? The more recruits, the better?" Su ye couldn't help but think.
Then Su ye looked at Dao Dao's protective buff.
The protection of the great road: Improved understanding! ! Your military intelligence will continue to improve! ! !
Su ye looked at the two buffs.
Improve your understanding! After fixing the buff, Su ye started the one-click sweep of daily tasks.
Just finished today's lord battle.
The system prompt tone also sounded.
[Ding: You get a hundred consecutive victory lord battle treasure chest! ! ! 】
"A hundred consecutive victories?" Su Ye was stunned. Before he knew it, he had already fought a hundred lord battles.
"Open." Su ye looked at the Hundred-Lottery Lord Battle treasure chest in front of him.
[Ding: You get the barracks refresh recruitment card x1! 】
[Ding: You get unit upgrade card x1! 】
[Ding: You get hero upgrade card x1! 】
[Ding: You get the barracks upgrade card x1! 】
[Ding: You have received an invitation to the bloody battle! 】
[Ding: You get the Abyss Exploration Card! 】
[Ding: You get an additional reward for Bailian SSS score: Devil’s Contract! 】
"Fuck!! Are you here for this?" Su Ye looked at the demon contract that was drawn out. You are a human. Are you a human?
You can come here anyway.
Su ye took a deep breath and then put it away. Today was equivalent to getting two devil's contracts, which was outrageous.
Su ye put it away directly, then looked at the territory and returned to the main world.
"Old man, I'll do it!!" Su ye's dragon roar sounded, and he opened the door directly and entered the old man's office.
The old man was still handling official business as usual.
"Here we come." The old man glanced at Su ye and couldn't help but said.
Su ye nodded.
"Sit." The old man put down the pen in his hand and looked at Su ye.
Su ye sat obediently opposite the old man. It seemed that the old man had something to tell him.
"Those people are looking for you?" the old man said to Su ye.
title_en: Chapter 666: I am really going to become a demon-suppressing cave. Chapter 665: This world still needs the gospel of the Lord.
